items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: He didn’t tell you the names of the tunes or what do you mean?

No, because him and Niels Pederson worked together for thirty years as a duo. I took Ed Thigpen’s place. And when I came in he said, “Just follow.” With Kenny I don’t remember any rehearsals, or not that much. Everything we did in the studio, we would run it one time. “Okay, you got it, that’s it.” “Well wait a minute.” “No, no, no, no.” Before I know it, it was taped. That’s the way it was.
Did you ever have a situation where you were supposed to do a gig, maybe a series of gigs with some people and it just didn’t jive? And you said you know, this isn’t—
